description: This Java source file defines the 'OrderByItem' class, which is used to represent an item in an SQL ORDER BY clause within the OFBiz framework. It includes parsing logic for order expressions, comparison logic for sorting entities, and methods for generating SQL order strings.

classes.name: OrderByItem
classes.description: Represents an item in an SQL ORDER BY clause, supporting parsing, comparison, and SQL string generation functionalities.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an object (String, EntityConditionValue, or OrderByItem) into an OrderByItem instance.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a string expression into an OrderByItem, interpreting order direction, null handling, and case sensitivity.

methods.name: checkOrderBy
methods.description: Validates that the order-by value is consistent with a given model entity.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares two GenericEntity objects based on the order-by value for sorting purposes.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Generates an SQL ORDER BY expression string based on the OrderByItem's configuration.

methods.name: makeOrderByString
methods.description: Constructs the SQL ORDER BY clause segment into a StringBuilder.
